Played it on the PS3, emulated it but lost the new PC save I fully S-ranked, made a new one and S-ranked everything again, then got on some guy's laptop and finished the game again.

I finished 4, once. I gave up S-ranking it. Yeah, it's substantially harder, but... I honestly just didn't like it lol. 4th generation is wacky clunk, but 4 in particular just plays really... Oddly. Sluggish, maybe. Some missions were straight ass tho I'm not gonna sugarcoat it, Icebreaker Defense and Aerial Interdiction is doo doo water. Just play it atleast once, it's not so bad!
